attributes.rule: <abbr title='Change of tariff subheading'>CTSH</abbr>: All non-originating materials used in the production of the good have undergone a change in tariff classification at the 6-digit level (subheading).
A chemical reaction, purification, mixing and blending, a change in particle size, production of standard materials, isomer separation or biotechnological processing is undergone.
A maximum of **50%** of the ex-works price (EXW) is made up of non-originating parts (MAXNOM).
Your goods contain a Regional Value Content (RVC) of at least **55%** of the Free on Board (FOB) cost of the goods.
